newsitem.title: USA: FOB Gulf Grain - Soybean basis weak, grains steady.
newsitem.headline: FOB Gulf Grain - Soybean basis weak, grains steady.

text.p: U.S. FOB Gulf soybean basis offers were weaker on Wednesday as CBOT futures surged but export business remained quiet, U.S. exporters said.
"We pulled the basis back a penny," one exporter said. "We had a pretty fierce runup on the board but there's not a whole lot going on down here."
Corn and wheat values were steady in quiet dealings.
On the export front, Argentine traders said Argentina bought 60,000 tonnes of new crop U.S. soybeans for October/November delivery and there was talk Brazil also bought new crop U.S. supplies.
Egypt bought 100,000 tonnes of U.S. hard red winter wheat for August/October delivery, export sources said.
